title: 从字符串中移除星号
summary: 每个星号删除它左侧最近的非星号字符并删除自身，返回最终字符串。
insight: 普通字符压入 StringBuilder；遇星号删除末字符，正好模拟最近未删除字符栈。
pitfalls: 题目保证星号左侧有可删字符
删除可能级联影响后续星号

solutions.title: 字符串构造器栈
solutions.idea: 末尾追加与删除完成线性模拟。

code.java: class Solution { public String removeStars(String s){StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();for(char ch:s.toCharArray())if(ch=='*')answer.setLength(answer.length()-1);else answer.append(ch);return answer.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun removeStars(s:String):String{val answer=StringBuilder();for(ch in s)if(ch=='*')answer.setLength(answer.length-1)else answer.append(ch);return answer.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:string removeStars(string s){string answer;for(char ch:s)if(ch=='*')answer.pop_back();else answer+=ch;return answer;} };
